FIELDS.NAME: Eternal Stone Monuments
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Customer Relations Manager, 555-123-4567, john.smith@eternalstonemonuments.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Eternal Stone Monuments specializes in the design, manufacturing, and retail of high-quality monuments and tombstones. Our operations include selecting premium stone materials and employing skilled artisans for precision engraving and customization to reflect the unique memorial preferences of our clients. We also offer installation services, ensuring each monument is securely placed with respect to local regulations and safety standards. We pride ourselves on maintaining a clean and safe work environment, with ongoing employee training programs that emphasize safety and sanitation. In addition to our physical showroom, we provide an online platform for customer convenience, allowing users to browse our products, request quotes, and manage orders efficiently. Our commitment to quality and compliance with all applicable regulations ensures that we deliver reliable, durable memorial products that meet the expectations of families during their time of need.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 05/10/2022; Cause: Incident during installation at a cemetery site; Amount: $1,000; Status: Resolved with insurance claim paid.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM to 5 PM; Saturday: 10 AM to 4 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Granite Vault, Grade A, Insulated
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and mobile security watchpersons during installation and high-traffic event periods.

Any materials used are standard stone products that do not fall under hazardous classifications.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Eternal Stone Monuments does not sponsor athletic teams as our focus is solely on the design and retail of monuments and tombstones. Our community engagement is primarily centered around providing memorial services and products.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Our team checks the certificates to ensure compliance and manage risk appropriately.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Eternal Stone Monuments has not faced any indictments or convictions related to fraud, bribery, arson, or arson-related crimes. The company's operations are conducted with a commitment to integrity and compliance with all regulations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Eternal Stone Monuments has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. All coverage has been maintained without interruption.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Eternal Stone Monuments does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we maintain our own dedicated team to manage all operations and services.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Eternal Stone Monuments carries Workers Compensation insurance to ensure compliance and protect our employees while they perform their duties.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Eternal Stone Monuments does not own or operate any other business, focusing solely on the design, manufacturing, and retail of monuments and tombstones.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Eternal Stone Monuments does not have any other insurance policies with the company. The only coverage currently held is the policy listed.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: Yes – Eternal Stone Monuments is involved in the manufacturing of monuments and tombstones as part of our operations, including the design and engraving processes. However, this is not considered manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products beyond incidental retail private label.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Eternal Stone Monuments does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus on the design and installation of monuments and tombstones without engaging in equipment rental activities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Eternal Stone Monuments has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a solid financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Eternal Stone Monuments does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations primarily involve the design and installation of stone monuments and tombstones, using materials that do not pose such risks.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Eternal Stone Monuments does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused on the design and installation of monuments and tombstones, which do not involve high-risk activities associated with catastrophic events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Eternal Stone Monuments has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a strong commitment to compliance and ethical practices.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Eternal Stone Monuments does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all fire safety regulations.
